title: US proposes Section 301 'excess capacity' tariffs on 14 partners Wed Nov 25: China 20%, highest; other rates not read (caps: 15% EU, Japan, Korea, Taiwan); not stacked on July's forced-labor 10% to 12.5%; comment and hearing first, could slip to January; notice not found
body:
# Section 301 excess-capacity tariffs: PROPOSED, not in force

| Object | Reported | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Status | proposed; notice and comment, hearing before effect; 'could push implementation into January' | Reuters via WTBX (read); Investing.com: January 2027 |
| Partners (14) | China, EU, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, India, Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Cambodia, Bangladesh, Singapore, Switzerland | search summary of several pages. **Mexico and Norway not included for now** (still reviewed; Nov 24 card 009 listed 16) |
| China | 20%, 'the highest rate'; adds to the first-term duties of about 25%; a truce caps second-term duties at 20%, expiring January 10. 40% absent an agreement (investingLive) | Reuters; CNBC |
| Others | rates not on any page read, only deal caps: 15% EU, Japan, Korea, Taiwan; **Malaysia 19% (Reuters) or 18% (investingLive): conflict** | the notice is to carry them |
| Vietnam / India | talks continue; Vietnam 20% with a deal, could be 35%; India deal rate 17% | Newsquawk listing, not opened |
| Stacking | not on top of the 10% or 12.5% forced-labor duties (July); on investingLive's reading the China step is 7.5 points for goods now at 12.5%. CNBC: China stacks on the 2018 25% | two different layers: do not read 'no stacking' as no stacking on 2018 |
| Carve-out | about $30bn of Chinese goods in a 'Board of Trade' process | Reuters |
| Reaction | China's foreign ministry: 'so-called overcapacity is a false issue'; a US official does not expect retaliation; Greer (CNBC via Newsquawk): tops up 'just a few percentage points' in most cases | no retaliation found |

- **Not found:** the Federal Register notice (regular public-inspection list at 09:09 ET held no USTR document), USTR release, comment deadline, hearing date, product list. Section 232, chips, drugs, fuel and fertilizer are not mentioned on any page read: UNKNOWN, not exempt.
- **Against card 20261124-009:** that card relayed sources saying 16 partners and duties 'stacking on existing ones'. The proposal names 14 and does not stack on the July layer.
- **So what:** smaller than the worst case, and later. The inflation step is small for partners already at their cap; China is the one with a real addition. CARL, HENRY and ZHAO judge.
